title: Create src/lib/scaffold.ts — project scaffolding logic
description: Create the core scaffolding module that orchestrates copying a template, substituting project name tokens, running npm install, and initializing git. This is the main business logic for 'rocket new'.
acceptanceCriteria: scaffold(templateName, projectName, destPath, options) function is exported
Template directory is copied to destPath with PROJECT_NAME substitution
npm install is run in the new project directory
git init is run in the new project directory

steps.details: Create src/lib/scaffold.ts. Define types: ScaffoldOptions { auth?: boolean; email?: boolean; pdf?: boolean }. Import processTemplate from template-engine.ts. Import path, child_process (execSync).

Export: async function scaffold(templateName: 'webapp' | 'website', projectName: string, destPath: string, options: ScaffoldOptions): Promise<void>. Compute srcDir = path.join(import.meta.dirname, '../../templates', templateName). Call processTemplate(srcDir, destPath, { PROJECT_NAME: projectName }).

steps.description: Run npm install in the scaffolded directory
steps.details: After processTemplate completes: execSync('npm install', { cwd: destPath, stdio: 'inherit' }). Using stdio: 'inherit' shows npm output to the user. Wrap in try/catch to handle npm install failures gracefully.

steps.description: Run git init in the scaffolded directory
steps.details: After npm install: execSync('git init', { cwd: destPath, stdio: 'inherit' }). Also run `git add -A` and `git commit -m 'Initial commit from Rocket'` for an initial commit.
If options.auth is false, delete auth-related files from destPath after copying (e.g., delete server/src/middleware/auth.ts if it exists). Implement this as a post-copy cleanup step.

technicalNotes: import.meta.dirname is the ESM equivalent of __dirname — requires Node.js 21.2+
Use execSync for npm install and git init since they're blocking operations and progress output is desirable
Consider adding a timeout to execSync for npm install in case of network issues
